items.name: Mourning-black coat
items.description: Black as Khaven's bell-rope, and cut long enough to kneel in. Nobody stops a man who wears one. GAME-ONLY.

items.name: Eyrie war-bow
items.description: A pass-warden's bow from the old toll-days, made again from the leaf. It throws an arrow from the eyrie to the road. GAME-ONLY.

items.name: Ember-quenched axe
items.description: Quenched in the embers of a cinder vent, not in water, the way the Ash-Walkers' bone-smiths say it was once done. It never quite cools. GAME-ONLY.

items.name: Root-dyed vigil robe
items.description: Dyed in a pit of root-water under the Shore's oldest trees and worn at the vigils for the laid-down. It is warm in any weather. GAME-ONLY.

items.name: Ox-root tincture
items.description: A thumb's depth of ox-root steeped in spirit. Bitter, and good for half an hour. The village's simples; not the Council's alchemy.

items.name: Ox-root cordial
items.description: The tincture's stronger sister, cut with salt and kept a season. Half an hour of strength in a mouthful.

items.name: Hare's-foot tincture
items.description: A thumb's depth of hare's-foot steeped in spirit. Bitter, and good for half an hour. The village's simples; not the Council's alchemy.

items.name: Hare's-foot cordial
items.description: The tincture's stronger sister, cut with salt and kept a season. Half an hour of agility in a mouthful.

items.name: Owl-light tincture

items.name: Owl-light cordial

items.name: Bear's-wort cordial
items.description: The tincture's stronger sister, cut with salt and kept a season. Half an hour of stamina in a mouthful.

items.name: Clear-head draught
items.description: Clears the head and fills what a caster spends.

items.name: Second-wind draught
items.description: A fighter's swig: the fire comes back into the arm.

items.name: Steady-hand draught
items.description: The hand steadies and the eye with it.

items.name: Bold-heart draught
items.description: One swallow and the next wager seems a sure thing.

items.name: Deep-breath draught
items.description: The breath comes long and slow, the way a beast's does.

items.name: Brine draught
items.description: Sea-salt and yarrow: the Salt-Menders' thread runs easier after it. GAME-ONLY simple; the Salt-Menders are CANON.

items.name: Clean-blood draught
items.description: It burns going down, and takes poisons, bleeds and the grey with it.

items.name: Tallow salve
items.description: Boar tallow and yarrow, rubbed into the skin. Blows slide off it for half an hour.

items.name: Scree salve
items.description: Bear fat and cinder-thistle ground with grit from the scree. The skin takes a blow like a hide does.

items.name: Golden Cask stew
items.description: Hob Linden's stew, from the receipt in the Cask's kitchen book. He says the secret is patience. It is the yarrow.

items.name: Harrow harvest feast
items.description: A Harvest Home board: boar, cheese and bread enough for five, laid out on a cloth. Nobody goes away hungry.

items.name: Bear-haunch broth
items.description: Boiled all day in a pilgrims' pot on the pass. It sticks to the ribs and stays there.

items.name: Pass-fire feast
items.description: Meat on the coals for a whole camp, the way the toll-wardens ate on the long nights. Five can share it.

items.name: Sap-glazed venison
items.description: Venison glazed with the tapper's sap and roasted slow. Veridian sap is CANON (book3 ch.4); the glaze is GAME-ONLY.

items.name: Shore feast
items.description: A Shore board: venison, mossback and fern-bread on broad leaves, for the whole party round the fire.
